# DESIGN.md — Cyber-Zen Premium Visual & UI/UX Governance
> **Role Context**: Principal Design Technologist & Lead UI/UX Architect Specification  
> **Target Aesthetic**: Cyber-Zen Premium Dark Mode (Anti-AI Slop System)

---

## 1. Philosophy & Anti-AI Slop Principles

### 1.1 What is "AI Slop" & Why It Is Strictly Banned
"AI Slop" refers to lazy, generic, template-driven designs generated by unguided AI models. In YourChords 2.0, the following elements are **EXPLICITLY BANNED**:

| Banned AI Slop Element | Mandated Cyber-Zen Alternative |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Generic Purple-to-Pink Gradients** on white/light gray backgrounds | Deep Obsidian (`#070a12`) canvas with controlled Cyan (`#06b6d4`) & Purple (`#a855f7`) neon highlights |
| **Boring White Cards** with harsh box shadows (`shadow-md`) | Glassmorphism surfaces (`rgba(15,23,42,0.65)` + `backdrop-blur-md` + subtle `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` border) |
| **Default System Serif/Sans Fonts** for musical content | Strict dual typography: `JetBrains Mono` for chords/tablature, `Inter`/`Outfit` for UI body & headers |
| **Flat, Static Layouts** lacking spatial depth | Multi-layered z-index depth, subtle glow overlays, dynamic grid lines, and tactile physical feedback |
| **Cluttered, Low-Contrast Chord Renderers** | Monospaced alignment, high-contrast cyan chord highlights, auto-scrolling visual indicators |

## 2. Typography & Hierarchy Scale

### 2.1 Font Family Designations

```css
/* Typography Token Assignments */
--font-chord: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;  /* Used ONLY for Chords, Tabs, Transpose Badges, Key Signatures */
--font-sans: 'Inter', 'Outfit', sans-serif; /* Used for Headers, Navigation, Buttons, Meta info */
```

- **`JetBrains Mono`**: Essential for chord lyrics alignment, transpose indicators, BPM counters, and music sheets. Guarantees fixed-width character precision so chord names align exactly above corresponding lyrics.
- **`Inter` / `Outfit`**: Clean, geometric, futuristic sans-serif typeface for interface hierarchy, search inputs, modal titles, and navigation headers.

### 2.2 Hierarchy & Size Ratio Scale

| Element | Class / Token | Size | Weight | Line Height | Tracking | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Display H1** | `text-4xl lg:text-5xl` | 36px / 48px | 800 (ExtraBold) | 1.1 | `-0.02em` | Main Song Title, Hero Headers |
| **Section H2** | `text-2xl lg:text-3xl` | 24px / 30px | 700 (Bold) | 1.25 | `-0.01em` | Section Headlines, Artist Names |
| **Card H3** | `text-lg lg:text-xl` | 18px / 20px | 600 (SemiBold) | 1.4 | `0em` | Card Titles, Modal Headers |
| **UI Body** | `text-sm lg:text-base` | 14px / 16px | 400 (Regular) | 1.6 | `0em` | Explanatory Text, Comments, Bios |
| **Chord Text** | `font-mono text-base font-bold` | 16px | 700 (Bold) | 1.0 | `0.05em` | Inline Chords (Cyan Neon Highlighted) |
| **Tablature** | `font-mono text-xs lg:text-sm` | 12px / 14px | 500 (Medium) | 1.2 | `0em` | Guitar/Ukulele Tablature Lines |

## 3. Palette & Contrast Token System

### 3.1 Color Tokens & Hex Values

```css
:root {
  /* Canvas & Elevations (Obsidian Spectrum) */
  --bg-obsidian-base: #070a12;       /* Deepest canvas background */
  --bg-obsidian-card: #0b0f19;       /* Card & Container surface */
  --bg-obsidian-elevated: #111827;   /* Hover / Modal / Dropdown surface */

  /* Neon Accent Tokens */
  --accent-cyan-neon: #06b6d4;       /* Primary interactive, active states, transposition */
  --accent-cyan-glow: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25);
  --accent-purple-neon: #a855f7;     /* Secondary accent, chord badges, user pro badges */
  --accent-purple-glow: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);

  /* Glassmorphism System Tokens */
  --glass-bg: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
  --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --glass-blur: blur(12px);

  /* Typography Colors */
  --text-primary: #f8fafc;           /* Slate 50 - High contrast text */
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;         /* Slate 400 - Subtitles, metadata */
  --text-muted: #64748b;             /* Slate 500 - Captions, disabled labels */
}
```

### 3.2 Tailwind Utility Integration

```tsx
// Tailwind CSS Token Reference (tailwind.config.ts)
colors: {
  obsidian: {
    DEFAULT: '#070a12',
    card: '#0b0f19',
    elevated: '#111827',
  },
  neon: {
    cyan: '#06b6d4',
    purple: '#a855f7',
  }
}
```

## 4. Glassmorphism & Surface Elevation

### 4.1 Glass Card Utility Pattern
Every card, floating toolbar, control panel, and modal MUST utilize the Cyber-Zen Glassmorphism specification:

```tsx
// Standard Cyber-Zen Glass Card Template
<div className="
  bg-[rgba(15,23,42,0.65)] 
  backdrop-blur-md 
  border border-white/10 
  rounded-2xl 
  p-6 
  shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.37)] 
  hover:border-cyan-500/30 
  transition-all 
  duration-300
">
  {/* Content */}
</div>
```

---

## 5. Micro-Interactions & Animation Guidelines

### 5.1 Tactile Feedback (Active Scale)
Interactive buttons, chord transpose toggles, auto-scroll buttons, and card links MUST provide tactile spring feedback on press:

```tsx
/* Button Active Scale Standard */
className="active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150 ease-out"
```

### 5.2 Hover Glow & Dynamic Shadows
Primary CTA buttons and active chord items must feature subtle neon light emissions on hover:

```tsx
/* Cyan Glow Hover Effect */
className="
  hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(6,182,212,0.35)] 
  hover:border-cyan-400/50 
  transition-shadow 
  duration-300
"
```

### 5.3 Timing & Easing Curves
- **Fast Micro-Interactions (Buttons, Badges)**: `150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`
- **Standard Panel Transitions (Modals, Drawers)**: `300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`
- **Auto-Scroll Smooth Movement**: `linear` or custom frame-based interpolation for chord sheets.

---

## 6. Component Specification Standard (Example)

### 6.1 Interactive Chord Sheet Display
- **Background**: `#070a12` base with a subtle grid overlay.
- **Lyrics**: `#f8fafc` rendered in `font-sans text-base leading-loose`.
- **Chords**: `text-[#06b6d4] font-mono font-bold text-base cursor-pointer hover:text-[#a855f7] hover:scale-105 transition-all`.
- **Key Badge**: `bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-mono text-xs`.
